properties.name: Grass Lake via Glen Alpine
properties.desc: Follows Fallen Leaf Road past Lily Lake, then the Glen Alpine Trail to the Grass Lake turnoff. Great waterfall views at Glen Alpine Falls.

properties.name: Susie Lake via Glen Alpine & PCT
properties.desc: Glen Alpine Trail to the Pacific Crest Trail junction, then on to rocky-shored Susie Lake in Desolation Wilderness.

properties.name: Gilmore Lake via Glen Alpine
properties.desc: Glen Alpine Trail then the Gilmore Lake spur - the classic route toward Mt. Tallac from the south.

properties.name: Lake Aloha via Heather Lake
properties.desc: The long haul: Glen Alpine Trail to the PCT, past Susie and Heather Lakes to the granite shores of Lake Aloha.

properties.name: Mt. Tallac via Mid-Tallac Trail
properties.desc: The unmarked Mid-Tallac route from the Lily Lake parking lot - climbs the southern scree side of Cathedral Ridge straight to the summit.

properties.name: Angora Lakes Loop (Church & Lily Lake Trails)
properties.desc: Steep Church Trail from the Fire House to the Angora Lakes parking lot, on to the resort for fresh lemonade, then the Lily Lake Trail down the talus slopes (big Fallen Leaf Lake views) to Lily Lake and Glen Alpine Road back to camp.

properties.name: Angora Lakes out & back (Church Trail)
properties.desc: The direct option: Church Trail from the Fire House to the Angora Lakes parking lot and on to the resort for lemonade, then straight back down the way you came.

properties.name: Mt. Tallac via Cathedral Lake
properties.desc: Scales the western shore of Fallen Leaf Lake past Floating Island Lake and Cathedral Lake to the 9,735 ft summit of Mt. Tallac.
